Hero_Desc_ViviDivine: Vivi, who inherited power from mistletoe. She let go of her hate-filled past and transformed into a new self. She has forgiven her mother and wishes to carry on what her mother set out to do.
Album_Hobby_ViviDivine: Meeting and talking with my sisters
Album_Wish_ViviDivine: Preserving the world as it is now
Album_ViviDivine1: Vivi still seems unused to her new appearance. She especially misses the wings she had for so long. I should stay close and help her adjust.
Album_ViviDivine2: Vivi no longer speaks the way she used to. I like her as she is now, but sometimes I miss the old Vivi. When I ask her to use that manner of speech, she gets flustered but reluctantly says a line or two. Of course, she blushes with embarrassment afterward.
Album_ViviDivine3: Vivi seems to doubt whether she deserves the power she received. She must be just as bewildered by having been given it so suddenly. I encouraged her, telling her that she could do it, and asked her to rely on me whenever she had worries. Vivi smiled openly and said she would tell me her troubles without holding back.
Album_ViviDivine4: Lately, Vivi has been arranging regular gatherings for the sisters. She seems to want Ui to meet the others more often and talk with them. Thanks to her, even the once-awkward Ui can now chat with her sisters comfortably.
Album_ViviDivine5: One night, Vivi came to me and confessed how anxious she felt about the responsibility placed on her. In tears, she said she might not deserve to carry on her mother's will. I comforted her by telling her that, precisely because she had hated her mother, turning that hatred into understanding and forgiveness was not something just anyone could do. I sat beside her through the night until she was able to steady her emotions.
Album_ViviDivine6: Lately, Vivi often visits the pond with Ui and talks for a long time. She listens to Ui's worries as she returns to reality and adjusts, and Vivi shares her own worries as well. When the two talk alone, memories of the time they spent together in the past seem to return.
Album_ViviDivine7: One day, I went with Vivi to a hill where the World Tree was clearly visible. Vivi said that many difficulties still lay ahead, but she felt the two of us could overcome them together. Blushing, she asked me to stay by her side for a long time as a companion who would help build a new world. The smile she showed me then still lingers in my mind.
LoveHero_ViviDivine: With you, Master, I can overcome whatever lies ahead.
LoveHeroCancel_ViviDivine: Ugh... I'll let you go for now, but you have to come back, okay?
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Hate1: She recoiled at the empty space inside the fried food and put down her fork. She even said she never wanted to eat anything like it again.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Hate2: She found food in a can unsettling and didn't want to eat it. After one bite, she pushed it away.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like1: She liked the drink, saying its contrasting sensations gave her a sense of security. She chatted for a while in the comfortable atmosphere before leaving.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like10: She still enjoys mixing the powder into black tea. One sip is enough to wash away all her fatigue.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like2: She ate a few more, apparently enjoying the taste. She seems to like bitter desserts.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like3: She still likes it because it helped her back when she couldn't stop sneezing. Its warm, filling feeling gives her peace of mind.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like4: She liked the dessert because it looked beautiful and tasted delicious.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like5: She says it is addictive enough to keep eating despite the sourness that makes her scrunch up her face.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like6: She enjoyed its mild taste, chewy surface, and hearty filling inside.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like7: She liked the rich sweetness, saying it helped her forget fatigue and worries.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like8: She seems to have grown used to the golden color. She says she thinks of this food whenever she is tired.
Food_ChefNote_ViviDivine_Like9: She says its brilliant, dazzling colors lift her mood. It looks almost too beautiful to eat right away.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_ViviDivine: Wherever you are, I will reach out my hand.
Gacha_Result_Line1_ViviDivine: Let's shape and beautify this world together.
ViviDivine_Growth: My name is Vivi. It's a pleasure to meet you.
ViviDivine_Growth1: I'm gradually getting used to this power.
ViviDivine_Growth2: The sprout inside me... is it growing well too?
ViviDivine_Victory1: This is a victory we seized together.
ViviDivine_Victory2: I hope this has made the world... a little better.
ViviDivine_Defeat1: I won't give up... not over something like this!
ViviDivine_Affinity1_1: I still... doubt myself. I wonder whether I deserve to possess this power.
ViviDivine_Affinity1_2: I will watch over this world in my own way... differently from my mother.
ViviDivine_Affinity2: Will you watch over the sprout I'm growing with me?
ViviDivine_Affinity1_3: Does this new form of mine... look strange to you?
ViviDivine_Affinity3: As my responsibilities have grown, I've started to understand your feelings a little better.
ViviDivine_Affinity4: Sometimes... no, often... may I come to you for advice?
ViviDivine_Affinity5: Whenever I worry about what lies ahead, I look to my sisters and you for strength.
ViviDivine_Affinity6: If I were alone, I couldn't have accomplished anything. But you have always supported me, Master.
ViviDivine_Affinity7: I want to build a world that is kind to everyone with you. So... please stay by my side for a long time.
ViviDivine_LevelUp: To make this world a kinder place.
ViviDivine_Equipment: I'm still not used to this appearance... I-it doesn't look strange, does it?
ViviDivine_HeroSkill: I will also cultivate the strength to protect this feeling.
ViviDivine_HeroUpgrade: I will accept it all: the power within me and the responsibility that comes with it.
ViviDivine_Board: So many feelings that have yet to bloom are waiting for us.
ViviDivine_DeckSetting1: Wherever you call me, I will go.
ViviDivine_DeckSetting2: Together, we can keep moving forward.
ViviDivine_Touch1: Is this also... a way of showing affection?
ViviDivine_Touch1_1: I-it's difficult when you pull me like that!
ViviDivine_Touch2_1: Could you... pet me a little longer?
ViviDivine_Touch2_2: I want to learn this warmth too... the warmth of your hand.
ViviDivine_DutchRubEnd2: Ugh, Master...! Could you be a little gentler?
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_ViviDivine_Skin1: Vivi (Divine), who started working at a maid cafe with Ui. She still seems awkward with customers, but her spirit of service is genuine.
ViviDivine_Growth1_Skin1: H-here's the parfait you ordered. Am I doing this right?
ViviDivine_Growth2_Skin1: I'll work even harder so everyone can have a wonderful time.
ViviDivine_LevelUp_Skin1: A more delicious dessert, just for you!
ViviDivine_Equipment_Skin1: I-I'm not used to clothes like this yet. It's a little embarrassing...
ViviDivine_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I think I'm getting used to it. Both the service and the cooking!
ViviDivine_Touch1_Skin1: Ugh, this isn't in the service manual...
ViviDivine_Touch1_1_Skin1: If you keep doing that, I'll cancel the spell that makes things delicious!
ViviDivine_Touch1_2_Skin1: C-customer! That's difficult to deal with while I'm working...
ViviDivine_Touch2_Skin1: That's a compliment sweeter than dessert.
ViviDivine_Touch2_1_Skin1: Hehe... Am I doing a good job?
ViviDivine_Touch2_2_Skin1: If you pet me like this... I'll get embarrassed...
ViviDivine_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: Ugh, what are you doing to the maid?!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_ViviDivine_Skin2: Vivi (Divine) is said to have contracted an illness of unknown origin. Is she truly in pain, or is she pretending? More tests seem necessary.
ViviDivine_Growth1_Skin2: Honestly… I feel like I've been ill for far too long.
ViviDivine_Growth2_Skin2: I can stand up now. Though I haven't fully recovered yet.
ViviDivine_LevelUp_Skin2: It seems the unbearable headache is gone.
ViviDivine_Equipment_Skin2: Is this a new medical device? I hope it really works this time.
ViviDivine_HeroSkill_Skin2: If I keep moving my body like this... I should return to normal, right?
ViviDivine_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Even if I get better, I still want to... lean on someone a little longer.
ViviDivine_Board_Skin2: Is it already time for a walk? Yes, please. You'll come with me, right?
ViviDivine_Touch1_Skin2: This isn't a new treatment... is it?
ViviDivine_Touch1_1_Skin2: I really am in pain, you know. I'm not joking!
ViviDivine_Touch1_2_Skin2: That will make it hurt even more!
ViviDivine_Touch2_Skin2: It feels like I've forgotten the pain. A little more, please.
ViviDivine_Touch2_1_Skin2: Hmm, I feel like I'm completely cured already.
ViviDivine_Touch2_2_Skin2: If you keep doing this... I don't think I need to leave the hospital.
ViviDivine_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: I'm up! I said I'm up!
Aside_Get_ViviDivine1: I will never lose... the feeling that dwells within me.
Aside_Upgrade_ViviDivine1: May the world this sprout faces as it grows become a kinder place.
ViviDivine_SPSkill3: Let a small wish become light!
ViviDivine_Ultimate1: I'll create a world that's kind to everyone.
ViviDivine_Ultimate3: I shall watch over all things!
ViviDivine_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master! I'm so glad... that you're here beside me.
ViviDivine_Gacha2: Let's make this world beautiful together.
ViviDivine_Gacha3: Wherever you are, I'll reach out to you.
ViviDivine_Line1: I will never overlook even the smallest heart.
ViviDivine_Line2: I will stand beside a withering heart until it blooms again.
ViviDivine_Line3: New sprouts will rise again, carrying everyone's feelings within them.
ViviDivine_EasterEgg_Deck: All seven sisters, together once more.
ViviDivine_EasterEgg_Deck2: Welcome back, Ui. We'll face tomorrow together.
ViviDivine_EasterEgg_Lobby: P-please stop. All that showing off is making even me embarrassed.
ViviDivine_StartJourney1: Come, let us move forward together.
ViviDivine_StartJourney2: With you, Master, I feel I could go anywhere.
ViviDivine_StartJourney3: Toward the new world we will create.
ViviDivine_SpecialScene1: Clench your fist and fill it with resolve!
ViviDivine_SpecialScene2: I am the master of this world! I am your master!
ViviDivine_SpecialScene3: Pass it on just as it is!
ViviDivine_Cool: Sometimes, clear thinking can soothe a troubled heart.
ViviDivine_Gloomy: You don't have to carry any emotion alone.
ViviDivine_Jolly: I'll step forward, for a world filled with love.
ViviDivine_Mad: I'll embrace even the fierce passions seething within chaos.
ViviDivine_Naive: Remembering the heart that was purest and most sincere.
ViviDivine_Shop1: Master, is there anything you need?
ViviDivine_Shop2: Tell me what you need, and I'll bring it right away.
ViviDivine_Shop3: This item will be useful to you, Master.
ViviDivine_Shop4: I'm glad to see you again.
ViviDivine_Shop5: How about this? It just came in.
ViviDivine_Shop6: Seeing you happy makes me happy too.
ViviDivine_Shop7: You're welcome to take your time looking around.
ViviDivine_Shop8: I've gathered only special things that suit you, Master.
ViviDivine_Shop9: These items seem to hold tremendous power.
ViviDivine_Shop10: I'll support the apostles' dreams too.
ViviDivine_Shop11: May the day come when everyone can fulfill their dreams.
ViviDivine_Shop12: Take all the time you need to choose, Master.
ViviDivine_Shop13: Thank you, as always, for coming to see me.
ViviDivine_Shop14: You'll be happy with whichever one you choose.
LoveLetter_ViviDivine:
Hello, Master. It's Vivi.
Since changing into this form, so many things have felt different.
The sensation of my feet on the ground, the wind brushing my cheeks...
Things that once felt ordinary became completely unfamiliar, and sometimes even frightening.
But walking around with you helped me realize that this is still a joyful and beautiful place.
So, Master...
Would you go on another date with me next time?
LoveCall_ViviDivine: Master...? Ah, hello. It's Vivi... Is it all right if I talk for a moment? I called because... lately I've felt something inside my heart growing larger and larger. It can make me so happy I feel ready to burst, trap me in an endless swamp of anxiety, make me so embarrassed that I want to hide somewhere at once, or make me sob and cry out in sadness. It even makes it hard to think about the destiny and power given to me, and the path this world should take... And this feeling has always been pointing toward you, Master. Ah... what I wanted to say was... would it be all right if I came to see you a little more often? I want to calm whatever is stirring inside me... in the warmth of your presence. You are... my gentle world, Master. Thank you for listening to such a long story. Then... I'll come see you again soon, Master.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_001: Master, will I be able to use the power I inherited from my mother properly?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_002: With great power comes great responsibility.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_003: Great power... great responsibility... Thank you for the advice, Master.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_004: Come to me whenever you have a problem.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_005: Then I won't hold back. I'll come to you often from now on.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_006: I'll think it through with you. Let's find the answer together.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP01_007: Master... thank you. I keep relying on you.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_001: Thank you for treating me again today. Next time, let me treat you.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_002: Hehe... it won't be easy to suit my tastes...!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_003: Ugh... that strange expression... You really are mischievous, Master.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_004: It's fine. I'm not expecting anything in return.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_005: I don't want to only receive. I want to become someone who can give to others too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_006: Oh! If you get the chance, I'd love to let you do it!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP02_007: I-is that really something to get so excited about? Now I'm embarrassed instead.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_001: Lately, so many happy things have happened... Sometimes I wonder if this is a dream.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_002: Then how about helping clean the banquet hall today?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_003: That pleasant thought vanished in an instant. Still, if you're truly busy, I'll help you.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_004: It might be a dream. I heard that in times like this, you're supposed to pull your cheek hard?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_005: I-is that really true?! Whoa... Phew, pulling my cheek didn't change anything!!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_006: There is no happiness without a reason. It's all thanks to your hard work, Vivi.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP03_007: Is that so? Hearing you say that makes me feel a little reassured.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP04_001: Master, are you busy with your schedule today...? If you have time... would you spend today with me?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP04_002: I would like to, but I'm short on Royal Candy, so I don't have the energy today...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP04_003: R-Royal Candy?! I don't know what you mean, but I'll try to find some.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP04_005: W-why are you suddenly shouting? Honestly, you can be so unpredictable sometimes, Master.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP04_006: Of course. I'll stick right by your side today, Vivi.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP04_007: ...You don't have to stick that close. Ahem... Still, time spent with you is precious.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_001: I want to give Silvia a present. Will you help me think of one, Master?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_002: How about giving her a fan?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_003: That's true! I've seen Silvia carrying a fan quite often.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_004: Silvia is a fine dragon even without a gift. She doesn't need one.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_005: ...That isn't quite the answer I wanted, but Silvia is indeed a remarkable dragon, and she does resemble me.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_006: Spending time with you is the greatest gift.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP05_007: Is that so? To be loved by someone must be the greatest blessing of all.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_001: I have a memory I miss terribly. Do you have one like that, Master?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_002: What memory do you miss, Vivi?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_003: I miss the time I spent happily walking across the plains with my sisters most of all. Sometimes I feel that if I close my eyes and open them again, I'll see that view once more.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_004: Sometimes I remember the place where I used to live too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_005: ...I see. You quietly miss a place you can no longer return to as well.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_006: The memory of raiding bakeries with Erpin is still thrilling.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP06_007: I don't know how to respond, but my heavy heart feels a little lighter.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_001: Sometimes it's nice to talk leisurely with you here in the banquet hall.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_002: The world looks more beautiful when you take time to rest.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_003: Room to breathe... making the world beautiful... You're right.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_004: I like it too. I'll stay at the church and protect your chance to rest.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_005: I won't let you overwork yourself alone. I can be a source of strength for others too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_006: Right? This is the only place where I can rest without doing paperwork.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP07_007: The priestess won't let that slide if she hears, but since you're with me now, I'll keep it secret.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_001: Sometimes I worry that Silvia is too mature. I wish she could be a little more childlike...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_002: Silvia is trying her best because she wants to help you too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_003: ...Is that so? Even so, I should make sure Silvia can live more comfortably.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_004: Isn't it good if she's well-behaved? She'll cause fewer accidents too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_005: Do you think so? Put that way, perhaps being well-behaved is better than always causing trouble.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_006: Then the three of us should go on a picnic. Children need to run around and play.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP08_007: That doesn't sound bad. Silvia likes being with you too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_001: The faint coffee aroma here is lovely.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_002: Does it smell strongly of coffee? Shall I air the place out?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_003: Hmm, I like it as it is... but please do whatever is convenient for you.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_004: I'm glad you like the aroma. I'll brew you a good one next time you visit.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_005: Yes, I'll look forward to it. I like resting this way; it has a charm of its own.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_006: The aroma must have lingered in the banquet hall because I made coffee.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP09_007: I see. I like it because it calms my heart.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_001: You're always busy taking care of the apostles. You should take care of yourself sometimes too...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_002: Thanks to your concern, my fatigue vanished completely. Thank you.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_003: Well then... I'll stay with you, so please rest now.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_004: Still, resting with you now makes me feel much better.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_005: I'm glad. If you collapsed from overwork, it would cause trouble everywhere.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_006: No matter what anyone says, I'm a very generous person.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP10_007: You must be very tired. Set that generosity aside for today and go back to bed early.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_001: What food do you like best, Master?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_002: I like feed that is sweet and full of savory flavor.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_003: F-feed? Your tastes are unusual, Master. Please never recommend it to me.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_004: What I love most in the world is eating strawberry cake.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_005: Perhaps because you've spent so long with the fairy queen, your tastes have started to resemble hers too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_006: I like air cutlets that leave you with a strange sense of betrayal best.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP11_007: Th-that's a little strange. Do you enjoy the feeling of betrayal...? You're impressive in more ways than one.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_001: You're an excellent cook, Master. I want to improve my cooking too... If you have time, could you teach me?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_002: There's no point in learning. It's a difference in talent, I suppose.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_003: It isn't pointless! I can do it well if I learn!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_004: You don't have to force yourself to imitate what someone else is good at.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_005: I don't want to imitate anyone. I think that when there's something you can't do, you should try to learn it.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_006: If you're willing, Vivi, I can teach you to cook.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP12_007: R-really? If you're not too busy, Master... I would love to learn!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_001: I'm afraid that even a small mistake of mine could hurt someone...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_002: I don't think that will happen, will it?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_003: Everyone makes mistakes. But I must not make any.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_004: Even if you make a mistake, you can look back and learn from it.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_005: But if I make a mistake, I may not be able to undo it.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_006: Let's do our best not to make mistakes. I'll help you along the way.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP13_007: Thanks to you, I feel a little lighter inside.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_001: When do you ever rest, Master? I only ever see you working.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_002: Thanks to Ner helping with work, I can rest sometimes.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_003: The priestess is very thoughtful, so you do get chances to rest sometimes.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_004: I've mastered the art of sleeping while doing paperwork.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_005: W-what?! Really? How little time do you have to sleep to develop a skill like that...?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_006: The time I spend meeting the apostles in the banquet hall is my time to rest.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP14_007: You must be tired, yet you still say that... Thank you, Master.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_001: Ugh... yesterday I... overslept without realizing it. When I woke up, the morning was long gone, and I was startled.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_002: It seems your fatigue had built up. Don't worry now; get some rest.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_003: I never thought a day would come when I could sleep so peacefully... It's a little strange.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_004: So that's why your hair looks like a bird's nest today?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_005: ...What?! W-was my hair really that messy...? Why didn't you tell me sooner?!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_006: Shall I come wake you myself next time?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP15_007: N-no need! I couldn't make you go to such trouble for me, Master!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_001: W-why are you staring at me like that?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_002: You look cheerful lately. It seems you have no worries.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_003: I always have worries. But I have so much happiness now that it almost overwhelms me.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_004: You have some of the bread you just ate on your mouth!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_005: Huh? Ah... I was walking around with that stuck there. Thank you for telling me, Master.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_006: I was wondering what dessert I could give you that people would praise me for choosing.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP16_007: If you've thought that hard about it, I'm more worried about what will appear.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_001: The witches' tastes seem more old-fashioned than I expected.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_002: You'd change your mind if you saw the witches drinking kudzu juice all day.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_003: Ugh... kudzu juice...? That does sound a little unpleasant...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_004: The UFC carrot fries made by the witches were really good.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_005: If you say so, I'll try them next time.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_006: I don't know. I don't like dry or bitter things.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP17_007: Your tastes are more childish than I expected, Master. But I think that has its own charm.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP18_001: Doesn't opening the banquet hall every day tire you out?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP18_003: Ugh... those words carry an incredible conviction.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP18_004: Because I'm doing it as part of spreading the faith...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP18_005: Even if it is for the faith, keeping this up every day is truly remarkable.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP18_006: It was hard at first, but it's fun as more apostles come to like it.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP18_007: Your kindness often causes problems too, Master. Though I suppose it is also one of your strengths...
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_001: I like the banquet hall because it puts my heart at ease whenever I visit.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_002: Shall I prepare something a little adventurous today?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_003: Oh... your eyes suddenly got sharp. What are you thinking about?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_004: Because I always work hard to create this kind of environment!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_005: I usually passed through without a thought, but hearing you explain it makes me realize how much care goes into it.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_006: You can relax whenever you want.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP19_007: Thank you, Master. But... I can't show you nothing but my lazy side!
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP20_001: What do you usually talk about with the apostles here?
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP20_002: I often discuss high-quality fun with the ghosts.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP20_003: I thought ghosts only pursued their own amusement, but you think about what fun means too.
Affinity_ViviDivine_EP20_004: I also talk with the dragons about their dreams.
